title: The Sublime and Subliminal (F4M)
description: The longer you listen, and better focused you train — The stronger my rewards will feel. And under the right circumstances? They can feel really, really, really good. In this file, the third installment in "The Two Sides" mini-series, I follow the same simple and yet subtle underlying premise of “Sleight of Voice”. Your conscious mind will drift along to the right-side, while battling the tempting curiosity that is my private conversation with your inner thoughts. Those sublime and subliminal whispers which shall for now remain a teasing mystery. It's time to recondition your subconscious to be more... receptive... to my voice.
author: Mistress Shibby
